home.title: Institutional market infrastructure for tokenized commercial real estate.
home.body: File KYC/KYB, wait for compliance approval, then the issuer registers OnchainID and mints MULK against a live EGKN proof.
home.investorBody: Connect MetaMask, file KYC/KYB, then sell via MulkToken.transfer after OnchainID is verified.
home.issuerBody: Register only admin-approved wallets, then fill primary subscriptions with verifiedMint.
home.adminBody: Review KYC/KYB dossiers, approve or reject with an audit trail. Admin never calls registerIdentity.

admin.gateBody: Connect an allowlisted officer wallet to review investor packages.
admin.forbidden: This wallet is not on the admin allowlist.
admin.queueHint: Off-chain packages. Issuer sees only approved wallets.

issuer.readyEmpty: No approved wallets waiting for on-chain KYC.

trade.title: Order terminal
trade.description: Executable settlement is MulkToken.transfer or issuer verifiedMint. The NAV ±10% book is indicative only.

onboarding.title: Register wallet
onboarding.description: Connect MetaMask, file the KYC/KYB package, then wait for compliance approval and issuer registerIdentity.
